reasons: Classification is sound: Section 13 already provides 12-month renewals with a 30-day opt-out (preferred on term/window), but the agreement lacks any vendor renewal reminder and leaves renewal-term pricing uncapped after the one-year freeze in Section 6, so it falls short of both the preferred and fallback price-protection elements.

Redline is directionally correct and minimally invasive: two inserted sentences (60-day TrueLink renewal notice; renewal fees capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%) with all original operative language, including the existing thirty (30) day non-renewal window, left intact.

Failed deterministic check 'non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days (number not found)' is a phrasing artifact — the retained 'thirty (30) days prior' already satisfies the parameter, so no edit was required there.
High changed-character ratio (0.799) overstates the intervention; the edit is additive insertion into a long clause, and the added protections cannot be achieved without new text.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains what changed and why, cites the playbook cap, and offers the 5% fallback.
